catches: BONUS IS MONTHLY: $100 per month for up to 6 consecutive months, each requiring a cumulative $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits that month - miss a month and that $100 is gone (later months still count)

Tracking begins the first day of the month after account opening - each month's $100 is paid approximately 10 days after the beginning of the next month
Account must be opened 9/9/2026-12/15/2026 with the promo code (auto-applied online); $25 minimum opening deposit
One bonus offer per client; account must be open, in good standing, with balance above zero at payout
Bonuses may be reported to the IRS for tax purposes
